subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your itinerary includes a direct flight from New York to Paris on December 15th and a return flight on December 22nd. Please find attached your e-ticket and boarding pass. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, Airline XYZ
